notes.title: 🔴 Walkthrough gameplay!
notes.content:
Join us to experience this old-school Action and Adventure game. Face hordes of enemies and challenges while helping Sirene, our protagonist, to find all the memory fragments and understand what is happening to her.

notes.title: Veil of Shadows - DEMO-1.1.0 is Live!
notes.content:
Hey! We have release the version demo-1.1.0 of Veil of Shadows. This version has a great addition on its mechanics. You will understand where the enemies are coming from!

Watching all the gameplays we could during the first week of the DEMO's release, we noticed that people were having problems understand how the enemies events worked, so we decided to pull a feature taht would be implemented in the future to now and that is already live in this version.

So, the black shadow that, when you get too close, it will come to Sirene and hit her. After that waves of enemies will start to spawn until the end of what we call Enemies Event. When it's finished a chest will be given to Sirene. This chest can drop multiple different items.

If there is one tip we can give, to make the gameplay more chill is to try to stay around the area where the black shadow was, because if you find another one when you are running away from the monsters you can start another event. So, [b]face your fears[/b]! All this mechanics plays a role on the character's story and the journey will explain it to you.

Enough for this post! I hope you can play Veil of Shadows' demo and have fun!

notes.title: Veil of Shadows - DEMO
notes.content:
After months of development, we are super excited to announce that our DEMO version will be live on Steam on Jan/29th!

[h2]about the game[/h2]
Veil of Shadows is an action-adventure game with roguelite elements. With a casual gameplay, you will control Sirène through forests and waste land in order to understand what's happening to her, why she's so confused and lost in a place that means nothing to her but fear, challenge and menace.

During her journey, you will be able to get different bows and arrows, shoot different types of monsters, complete some quest, get a companion and fight bosses [i](not on the DEMO, to not give spoilers)[/i].

notes.title: SteamDeck compatibility is on the way!
notes.content:
[h3]We are happy to announce that Veil of Shadows will be fully compatible with Steam Deck, like that, we target better our community.[/h3]

Knowing that Veil of Shadows has a casual gameplay and with 2D environment and sprites, this game is perfectly suitable to Steam Deck ambiance. So we decided that being 100% compatible with this platform was a must.

So, now you will be able to play it in multiple platforms, using the same save game and having fun on the go.

notes.title: Exciting News: "Veil of Shadows" Now Speaks Your Language!
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce that Veil of Shadows has expanded its horizons to support multiple languages. Immerse yourself in the adventure on your language. Whether you prefer English, Français, Português, or more, we've got you covered!

Dive into the game and experience the captivating storyline in a language that feels like home. The world of Veil of Shadows is now more accessible than ever. Get ready to uncover the mysteries, explore the unknown, and enjoy a truly immersive gaming experience in your preferred language.

Don't wait! Wishlist "Veil of Shadows" now! 🎮✨ #GamingCommunity #MultiLanguageSupport #VeilOfShadows

[url=https://x.com/imponixgames/status/1715674752059138219?s=20]Check this out on X (Twitter)![/url]
